description.value: South Castle Korean Restaurant is a Korean eatery on East 2nd Street in North Vancouver. The Korean name '남한산성 순대' (Namhansanseong Sundae) suggests a focus on traditional Korean cuisine, particularly sundae (Korean blood sausage). Dine-in service is available, with catering and reservations handled by phone.

address.value: 141 2nd St E, North Vancouver, BC V7L 1C2
